Assessment of BA.evidence_source: CFAs were conducted using the Analysis of Moment Structures Programme (AMOS v.21; Arbuckle, 2012) to examine the factorial structure of the BAS. A single-factor model where all items loaded onto a single latent variable was assessed to examine the factorial validity of the model proposed by Avalos et al. (2005; see Fig. 1).

Correlation between body appreciation an.evidence_source: The text states that "indices of validity were established by assessing bivariate correlations between derived factors and measures of BMI" but does not provide the actual correlation coefficients.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the statistical analyses performed, including handling missing data and conducting Confirmatory Factor Analyses (CFAs) to examine the factorial structure of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). It describes the assessment of single-factor and two-dimensional models, the selection of goodness-of-fit indices, and the interpretation of factor loadings. The section also mentions testing for configural and structural invariance across sex and investigating sex differences and bivariate correlations with BMI and self-esteem.
